start.speaker: Elara
start.text: Potions, scrap, relics — I buy and sell. Stock refreshes each visit.

many_deaths.speaker: Elara
many_deaths.text: Death is the tower's habit, not your failure. Rest in the hub, sharpen steel, try again.

veteran.speaker: Elara
veteran.text: You've climbed enough times that the echoes know your step. Spend that knowledge wisely.
